words.tr: phrase. 一项详细的研究；对某一主题进行全面而细致的分析
words.ex: He did a detailed study of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他对这些旧书做了详细的研究。
words.en: An in-depth and thorough examination of a subject.

words.tr: phrase. 一名初级讲师
words.ex: He is a junior lecturer at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名初级讲师。
words.en: A university teacher or academic who holds a low-ranking position, typically below the rank of a lecturer.

words.tr: phrase. 一份参考文献列表；书目清单
words.ex: He wrote a list of bibliography for his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的研究论文写了一份参考文献列表。
words.en: A list of sources used in a research paper or book.

words.tr: phrase. 一种以科学为基础的方法
words.ex: The teacher uses a scientific-based approach to teach science.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一种基于科学的方法来教授科学。
words.en: A method based on scientific principles and evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 一个关于学习技巧的研讨会
words.ex: He attended a study skill seminar last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一个学习技巧研讨会。
words.en: A seminar designed to teach students effective study techniques and strategies to enhance their learning and academic performance.

words.tr: phrase. 学术导师；在学术机构中指导学生（尤其是研究生）进行学习或研究的教师或教授
words.ex: My academic supervisor helped me choose the right research topic.
words.ex_cn: 我的学术导师帮我选择了合适的研究课题。
words.en: An academic supervisor is a person who guides and oversees the academic work of students, especially in higher education and research settings.

words.tr: phrase. 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦（德裔美国科学家）
words.ex: Albert Einstein invented the theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦发明了相对论。
words.en: Albert Einstein was a theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics (alongside quantum mechanics). His work is also known for its influence on the philosophy of science.

words.tr: 专有名词. 亚历山大大帝（古代马其顿国王，著名的军事统帅）
words.ex: Alexander the Great conquered many lands.
words.ex_cn: 亚历山大大帝征服了许多土地。
words.en: Alexander the Great was a king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon and one of history's most successful military commanders.

words.tr: phrase. 应聘表；申请表
words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.tr: phrase. 助理讲师（在大学或学院中职称低于讲师的教职人员）
words.ex: He is an assistant lecturer at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名助教。
words.en: A university teacher who assists a senior lecturer or professor.

words.tr: phrase. 在图书馆后面
words.ex: The bike is behind the library.
words.ex_cn: 自行车在图书馆后面。
words.en: Located at the back of the library.

words.tr: phrase. 生物学课程
words.ex: He takes a biology course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期上一门生物课。
words.en: A biology course is an educational class that focuses on the study of living organisms and their interactions with each other and their environments.

words.tr: phrase. 生物学实验室
words.ex: Students spend a lot of time in the biology lab conducting experiments.
words.ex_cn: 学生们花了很多时间在生物实验室进行实验。
words.en: A room or facility equipped for conducting experiments and research in the life sciences, typically containing microscopes, specimens, and scientific apparatus.

words.tr: phrase. 黑洞
words.ex: The star fell into a black hole.
words.ex_cn: 这颗恒星落入了一个黑洞。
words.en: A black hole is a region of space having a gravitational field so intense that no matter or radiation can escape.

words.tr: phrase. 通过电子邮件；以电子邮件方式
words.ex: I sent the report by email.
words.ex_cn: 我通过电子邮件发送了报告。
words.en: Using email as a method of communication or sending information.

words.tr: phrase. 校园参观；学校园区导览
words.ex: We went on a campus tour yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天参观了校园。
words.en: A guided visit around a university or college campus, typically for prospective students or visitors.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.tr: phrase. 化学实验室
words.ex: The students work in chemical labs every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都在化学实验室工作。
words.en: Chemical labs are facilities equipped for conducting chemical experiments and research.

words.tr: phrase. 化学楼；化学实验楼
words.ex: The chemistry building is located at the north end of the campus.
words.ex_cn: 化学楼位于校园的北端。
words.en: A building dedicated to chemistry departments, labs, and research facilities.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童心理学；研究儿童心理发展及其行为的学科
words.ex: Understanding child's psychology is crucial for effective education.
words.ex_cn: 理解儿童心理学对于有效的教育至关重要。
words.en: The study of the mental processes and behaviors of children, focusing on how they develop and interact with their environment.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机课程；电脑培训课程
words.ex: He takes computer courses every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期都上计算机课程。
words.en: Courses that teach the use and programming of computers.

words.tr: phrase. 社区学院（美国提供两年制高等教育的公立学院，通常授予副学士学位）
words.ex: She decided to attend a community college to save money.
words.ex_cn: 她决定去社区大学就读以节省学费。
words.en: A community college is a type of educational institution providing post-secondary education and lower-level tertiary education, granting certificates, diplomas, and associate's degrees.

words.tr: phrase. 会议时段；研讨会环节；会议的某一进行阶段
words.ex: He attended a conference session about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的会议环节。
words.en: A conference session is a specific period of time during a conference when a particular topic is discussed or a specific event takes place.

words.tr: phrase. 课程注册；选课登记
words.ex: The process of course registration is now online.
words.ex_cn: 课程注册的过程现在已经在线进行。
words.en: The process of signing up for classes or courses at an educational institution.

words.tr: phrase. 课程网站，用于发布课程资料、通知和作业的在线平台
words.ex: The course website provides all the necessary materials for the students.
words.ex_cn: 课程网站为学生提供了所有必要的材料。
words.en: A website that provides information, resources, and materials for a specific academic course, such as syllabi, lecture notes, assignments, and announcements.

words.tr: phrase. 封面页；封面文件（用于覆盖和保护文件或报告的第一页，通常包含标题、作者、日期等信息）
words.ex: He put a cover sheet on top of the report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告上面放了一张封面纸。
words.en: A cover sheet is a sheet of paper that is placed on top of a document to provide information about its contents.

words.tr: phrase. 要求高的课程；难度大、需要大量时间和精力投入的课程
words.ex: He is taking demanding courses this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期正在上一些要求很高的课程。
words.en: Courses that require a high level of effort and dedication.

words.tr: phrase. 部门规章；部门指导方针
words.ex: The department guidelines say to submit the form on time.
words.ex_cn: 部门指南要求按时提交表格。
words.en: Official rules or instructions issued by a university department for its students or staff.

words.tr: phrase. 部门资金；指分配给某个部门的财政支持或经费
words.ex: The departmental funding was cut last year.
words.ex_cn: 部门资金去年被削减了。
words.en: Funding allocated specifically to a department within an organization for its operations or projects.

words.tr: phrase. 直接引语；直接引用的话
words.ex: He used direct quotes from the book.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了书中的直接引语。
words.en: Direct quotes are the exact words that someone has said or written, used in a piece of writing or speech.

words.tr: phrase. 远程教育
words.ex: He is doing distance learning at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里进行远程学习。
words.en: Distance learning is a way of studying where tuition is carried out over the internet or by post, so that you do not need to attend a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 下载材料
words.ex: Please download the materials before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议前下载材料。
words.en: Obtain digital files or resources from a remote server or the internet and save them to your local device for offline access.

words.tr: phrase. 得出结论；推断出结果
words.ex: He drew conclusions from the data.
words.ex_cn: 他从数据中得出结论。
words.en: To reach a decision or opinion after considering the facts or evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；截止日期；预产期
words.ex: The due date for the homework is Friday.
words.ex_cn: 作业的截止日期是星期五。
words.en: The date by which something is expected to happen or be completed.

words.tr: phrase. 经济学课程；讲授经济学知识的课堂
words.ex: He takes economics class every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一上经济学课。
words.en: A course that studies the production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 经济学部分；经济版块（通常指报纸、书籍或课程中关于经济学的内容部分）
words.ex: He read the economics section in the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他读了报纸的经济版块。
words.en: The part of a publication, course, or library that deals with the study of how money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.tr: phrase. 教育心理学（研究教育过程中的心理现象和规律的学科）
words.ex: He is studying education psychology to help children learn better.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习教育心理学，以帮助孩子们更好地学习。
words.en: Education psychology is the study of how people learn in educational settings, the effectiveness of educational interventions, the psychology of teaching, and the social psychology of schools as organizations.

words.tr: phrase. 教育成就；学业成绩
words.ex: He showed great educational achievement by graduating with honors.
words.ex_cn: 他以优异成绩毕业，展现了出色的教育成就。
words.en: Educational achievement refers to the level of schooling an individual has completed or the degrees and certifications they have earned.

words.tr: 名词短语。教育政策；指政府或教育机构制定的关于教育体系、教学内容、管理方式等方面的指导方针和规则
words.ex: The government changed educational policies last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年政府改变了教育政策。
words.en: Educational policies refer to the principles and guidelines that govern the operation and management of educational systems and institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 教育项目；教育计划
words.ex: The educational program aims to improve students' critical thinking skills.
words.ex_cn: 这个教育程序旨在提高学生的批判性思维能力。
words.en: An educational program is a structured set of activities aimed at achieving specific educational objectives.

words.tr: 名词短语。工程课程，指与工程学相关的各类学术课程，如机械工程、电子工程、土木工程等
words.ex: He takes engineering courses at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学修工程课程。
words.en: Engineering courses are academic programs that focus on the application of scientific and mathematical principles to design, build, and maintain structures, machines, and systems.

words.tr: phrase. 英语课；英语课程
words.ex: He goes to english class every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一去上英语课。
words.en: A session or course where the English language is taught.

words.tr: phrase. 注册信息；入学信息；登记资料
words.ex: He checked the enrolment information for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了该课程的注册信息。
words.en: Information related to the process of registering or enrolling in a course, program, or institution.

words.tr: phrase. 考试成绩；测验结果
words.ex: He is waiting for his exam results.
words.ex_cn: 他正在等待他的考试成绩。
words.en: The outcomes or achievements from taking a test.

words.tr: phrase. 考试技巧；应试方法
words.ex: He practices exam techniques to finish faster.
words.ex_cn: 他练习考试技巧以更快完成。
words.en: Methods or strategies used to approach and succeed in examinations.

words.tr: phrase. 教职员工委员会；由教师组成的委员会
words.ex: The faculty committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 教职委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee composed of members of the academic staff of a university.

words.tr: phrase. 期末考试；最终考试
words.ex: He is preparing for the final exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为期末考试做准备。
words.en: A final exam is a test given at the end of a course of study to determine the student's knowledge and understanding of the material.

words.tr: phrase. 财务报告；财政报告
words.ex: The company's financial report showed a significant increase in profits.
words.ex_cn: 公司的财务报告显示利润显著增加。
words.en: A financial report is a document that presents the financial activities and condition of a business, individual, or any other entity.

words.tr: phrase. 外语教师；教授非母语语言的教师
words.ex: Foreign language teachers help students speak new languages.
words.ex_cn: 外语老师帮助学生学习说新的语言。
words.en: Foreign language teachers are educators who specialize in teaching languages that are not native to the students, often employing various methods to facilitate language acquisition and cultural understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 正式的词语；用于正式场合或书面语中的表达方式
words.ex: He uses formal words in his job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在求职面试中使用正式的词语。
words.en: Language that is official, serious, or suitable for academic or professional contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 法国文学
words.ex: He reads french literature every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读法国文学。
words.en: French literature refers to the body of written works produced in the French language, particularly those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr: phrase. 大学新生研讨课；为新生开设的小型讨论课程
words.ex: The freshman seminar is designed to help new students adapt to college life.
words.ex_cn: 新生研讨课旨在帮助新生适应大学生活。
words.en: A freshman seminar is a course designed to introduce first-year college students to academic life and help them develop skills necessary for success in higher education.

words.tr: phrase. 进一步的研究
words.ex: We need further research to understand this problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要进一步的研究来理解这个问题。
words.en: Additional studies or investigations carried out to explore a subject in more depth or to verify previous findings.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做讲座；讲课
words.ex: He gives a lecture on math every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都做一场数学讲座。
words.en: Deliver an educational talk to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业于（某学校）
words.ex: He graduated from high school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年从高中毕业。
words.en: To complete a course of study at a school, college, or university and receive a degree or diploma.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.tr: phrase. 客座讲师
words.ex: The university often invites guest lecturers to share their expertise in various fields.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学经常邀请客座讲师来分享他们在各个领域的专业知识。
words.en: A guest lecturer is a person who is invited to give a lecture or talk at an educational institution or event, usually as a one-time or short-term engagement, and who is not a regular member of the institution's staff.

words.tr: 短语动词。发表演讲；做讲话
words.ex: He will have a speech tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要发表演讲。
words.en: To deliver a formal talk or address to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 历史背景
words.ex: The book explains the historical background of the war.
words.ex_cn: 这本书解释了这场战争的历史背景。
words.en: The historical background refers to the events, conditions, or circumstances that are relevant to a particular situation, event, or person in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 历史系；历史学系（大学或学院中负责教授和研究历史的学术部门）
words.ex: He works in the history department at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的历史系工作。
words.en: The academic division of a university or college that focuses on the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍（供学生住宿的房屋或建筑群）
words.ex: The students live in the halls of residence near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在校园附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: Halls of residence are buildings where students live, typically provided by a university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 识别号码；身份编号；证件号码
words.ex: He gave his identification number to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的身份证号码给了警察。
words.en: A unique number assigned to identify a particular person, object, or entity.

words.tr: phrase. 问询处；信息咨询办公室；服务台
words.ex: He went to the information office to ask for directions.
words.ex_cn: 他去信息处问路。
words.en: A place where information is provided to the public, often about a specific location or service.

words.tr: phrase. 内部审查办公室；内部审计部门
words.ex: The internal review office checked the report.
words.ex_cn: 内部审查办公室检查了这份报告。
words.en: An internal review office is a department within an organization that is responsible for conducting internal audits and reviews to ensure compliance with policies and regulations.

words.tr: phrase. 国际学生；留学生
words.ex: International students live in the dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 国际学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: International students are students who have chosen to undertake all or part of their tertiary education in a country other than their own and are often in the country on a student visa.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网来源；网络资源
words.ex: He found the answer from an internet source.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个网络来源找到了答案。
words.en: An internet source refers to any information or data obtained from the internet, often used for research, reference, or citation.

words.tr: phrase. 法律图书馆；法学院图书馆；法律资料室
words.ex: He reads books in the law library.
words.ex_cn: 他在法律图书馆读书。
words.en: A law library is a library that specializes in legal materials, including statutes, case law, and legal treatises.

words.tr: phrase. 顶尖科学家；权威科学家；领军科学家
words.ex: Leading scientists are working on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 领先的科学家们正在研究气候变化。
words.en: Leading scientists are those who are at the forefront of their field, often recognized for their significant contributions and expertise.

words.tr: phrase. 大讲堂；阶梯教室
words.ex: The students walk to the lecture hall for class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们走向礼堂上课。
words.en: A large room in a college or university where lectures are given.

words.tr: phrase. 讲义；课堂发放的资料
words.ex: The teacher gave us lecture handouts before class.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课前给了我们讲义。
words.en: Documents given to students during or before a lecture.

words.tr: phrase. 讲义；课堂笔记
words.ex: He reads his lecture notes before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前阅读他的课堂笔记。
words.en: Lecture notes are notes taken by a student during a lecture, or notes provided by the lecturer for the students to follow the lecture.

words.tr: phrase. 阶梯教室
words.ex: The students went to the lecture theatre for biology class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去讲堂上生物课。
words.en: A large room or hall used for lectures, typically with tiered seating for the audience.

words.tr: phrase. 法律改革；法制改革
words.ex: The government wants to start legal reform.
words.ex_cn: 政府想开始法律改革。
words.en: Legal reform refers to the process of changing laws in order to improve them, often to make them more just, effective, or appropriate to current societal needs.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆参观；图书馆导览
words.ex: We went on a library tour yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天参观了图书馆。
words.en: A guided visit to explore the facilities, resources, and services of a library.

words.tr: phrase. 航海日志；飞行日志；记录簿；登记册
words.ex: The sailors write daily notes in log books.
words.ex_cn: 水手们每天在日志本上写笔记。
words.en: A log book is a record of events, especially one kept by the captain of a ship.

words.tr: phrase. 主礼堂；主报告厅
words.ex: The main auditorium was filled to capacity for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的主礼堂座无虚席。
words.en: The primary large hall in a college used for ceremonies, lectures, and events.

words.tr: phrase. 主校区；校本部
words.ex: The main campus of the university is located in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 大学的主校区位于市中心。
words.en: The principal grounds of a university or college, where the majority of its buildings and facilities are located.

words.tr: phrase. 主讲堂；主演讲室
words.ex: The students gather in the main lecture room every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周一都在主讲教室集合。
words.en: The main lecture room is a large room in a school or university where lectures are given to a large number of students.

words.tr: phrase. 总公司；总部；主要办事处
words.ex: The main office is located in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 主要办公室位于市中心。
words.en: The principal office or headquarters of an organization, especially a business or company.

words.tr: phrase. 管理阶层；管理层；管理课程
words.ex: The management class is designed for professionals seeking to enhance their leadership skills.
words.ex_cn: 这个管理类别是为那些寻求提升领导技能的专业人士设计的。
words.en: A course or subject focused on the principles and practices of managing people and resources.

words.tr: 硕士学位；研究生
words.ex: He wants to earn a master degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他想获得工程学的硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.tr: phrase. 大众传播学
words.ex: He is taking media studies at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习媒体研究。
words.en: The academic discipline that deals with the content, history, and effects of various media; in particular, the mass media.

words.tr: phrase. 医学文献；医学著作
words.ex: He reads medical literature every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上阅读医学文献。
words.en: Medical literature refers to the body of published works that discuss medical topics, including research articles, reviews, and case studies.

words.tr: phrase. 新课程；新的课程
words.ex: The school offers new courses this semester.
words.ex_cn: 这学期学校开设了新课程。
words.en: New courses refer to recently introduced educational programs or classes designed to provide new knowledge or skills.

words.tr: phrase. 新生；新学生
words.ex: New students are learning English this semester.
words.ex_cn: 新生这学期正在学习英语。
words.en: New students are individuals who have recently enrolled in an educational institution and are beginning their studies.

words.tr: phrase. 新的时间表；新的时刻表
words.ex: The company introduced new timetables for the upcoming season.
words.ex_cn: 公司为即将到来的季节引入了新的时间表。
words.en: Updated schedules for classes or activities, typically for a new term or period.

words.tr: phrase. 下周的辅导课；下周的教程
words.ex: We will meet in next week's tutorial.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在下周的辅导课上见面。
words.en: The tutorial scheduled for the upcoming week.

words.tr: phrase. 核工程
words.ex: He is studying nuclear engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习核工程。
words.en: Nuclear engineering is the branch of engineering concerned with the application of the breakdown (fission) as well as the fusion of atomic nuclei and the application of other sub-atomic physics, based on the principles of nuclear physics.

words.tr: phrase. 在线资源；网络资源
words.ex: The internet provides a vast amount of online resources for learning new skills.
words.ex_cn: 互联网为学习新技能提供了大量的在线资源。
words.en: Online resources refer to information, tools, and services that are accessible via the internet, used for various purposes such as education, research, and entertainment.

words.tr: phrase. 开卷考试：允许考生查阅教材、笔记或其他资料的考试形式
words.ex: He passed the math test in open book exams.
words.ex_cn: 他在开卷考试中通过了数学测验。
words.en: Examinations in which students are allowed to use their textbooks and notes.

words.tr: phrase. 在校外；不住校
words.ex: He lives off campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校外，靠近公交车站。
words.en: Off campus refers to activities or locations that are situated away from the university or college grounds.

words.tr: phrase. 热门课程；受欢迎的课程
words.ex: Math and English are popular courses in high school.
words.ex_cn: 数学和英语是高中里的热门课程。
words.en: Courses that are widely liked or appreciated by many people.

words.tr: phrase. 研究生：已经获得学士学位并继续攻读硕士或博士学位的学生。
words.ex: Postgraduate students are writing their theses.
words.ex_cn: 研究生们正在写他们的论文。
words.en: A postgraduate student is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, often in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.tr: phrase. PowerPoint演示文稿；用微软PowerPoint软件制作的幻灯片报告
words.ex: He made a PowerPoint presentation about animals.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于动物的PowerPoint演示文稿。
words.en: A PowerPoint presentation is a presentation created using Microsoft PowerPoint software, often consisting of slides, used to present information in meetings, classrooms, and other settings.

words.tr: phrase. 具备资格的学生；合格的学生
words.ex: The school accepts qualified students every year.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年录取合格的学生。
words.en: Students who have met the necessary standards or requirements to be considered competent in a particular subject or field.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书；工具书；参考资料书籍
words.ex: He uses reference books to find answers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考书来找答案。
words.en: Books intended to be consulted for authoritative information rather than read through.

words.tr: phrase. 登记处；注册办公室；户籍室
words.ex: He went to the register's office to enroll in class.
words.ex_cn: 他去注册办公室报名上课。
words.en: An office where official records are kept and where you can get copies of documents such as birth, marriage, and death certificates.

words.tr: phrase. 登记表
words.ex: He filled out the registration form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了注册表。
words.en: A registration form is a document with a series of questions that you fill in when you want to join something, such as a course, event, or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 注册时段；登记环节
words.ex: He attended the registration session on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了周一的注册会议。
words.en: A registration session is a period of time during which individuals can officially sign up or enroll for a particular event, course, or service.

words.tr: phrase. 研究论文；学术论文
words.ex: He wrote a research paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的研究论文。
words.en: A research paper is a piece of academic writing that provides analysis, interpretation, and argument based on in-depth independent research.

words.tr: phrase. 研究项目；科研项目
words.ex: He works on two research projects this year.
words.ex_cn: 他今年在做两个研究项目。
words.en: Research projects are systematic investigations aimed at discovering new knowledge or understanding in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 馆藏保留书籍；图书馆专藏（不外借的）特藏图书
words.ex: The library keeps reserved collection books for students to use only in the reading room.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把指定收藏的书放在阅览室，供学生仅在室内使用。
words.en: Books that are kept in a special section of a library and require special permission to access.

words.tr: phrase. 宿舍楼
words.ex: The residents hall is quiet at night.
words.ex_cn: 学生宿舍晚上很安静。
words.en: A building where students live, typically on a college or university campus.

words.tr: phrase. 已排定时间的课程；按计划安排的班级课程
words.ex: He attends his scheduled classes every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都参加安排好的课程。
words.en: Classes that have been planned and arranged to take place at specific times.

words.tr: phrase. 精选的材料；经过挑选的物料
words.ex: He chose selected materials for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目挑选了选定的材料。
words.en: Materials that have been carefully chosen for a specific purpose or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 社会心理学
words.ex: Social psychology studies how individuals' thoughts, feelings, and behaviors are influenced by the actual, imagined, or implied presence of others.
words.ex_cn: 社会心理学研究个体思想、情感和行为如何受到他人实际、想象或暗示存在的影响。
words.en: Social psychology is the scientific study of how people's thoughts, feelings, and behaviors are influenced by the actual, imagined, or implied presence of others.

words.tr: phrase. 春假（尤指美国学校在春季的假期）
words.ex: Many students travel during spring break to enjoy the warm weather.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在春假期间旅行，享受温暖的天气。
words.en: A vacation period in early spring at universities and schools in some countries.

words.tr: phrase. 学生卡
words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.tr: phrase. 学生中心；学生会；学生活动中心
words.ex: The student centre helps students with their problems.
words.ex_cn: 学生中心帮助学生解决他们的问题。
words.en: A building or area on a university or college campus that provides facilities and services for students, such as study spaces, social areas, and administrative support.

words.tr: phrase. 学生折扣；专为学生提供的价格优惠
words.ex: The student discount saves money on bus tickets.
words.ex_cn: 学生折扣可以节省公交车票的钱。
words.en: A reduction in price offered to students, typically upon presentation of a valid student ID.

words.tr: phrase. 学生折扣卡（供学生享受购物、交通、娱乐等优惠的证件）
words.ex: Students use discount cards to save money on books.
words.ex_cn: 学生使用学生证来节省买书的费用。
words.en: Cards that provide discounts to students, typically requiring proof of student status.

words.tr: phrase. 学生电子邮箱账户
words.ex: Please check your student email account for important updates.
words.ex_cn: 请检查您的学生电子邮件账户以获取重要更新。
words.en: An email address provided by a school or university for student use.

words.tr: phrase. 学生贷款；为支付教育费用而向学生提供的借贷资金
words.ex: He took out student loans to pay for college.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了学生贷款来支付大学费用。
words.en: A student loan is a sum of money borrowed by a student to pay for their education, which must be repaid with interest after the student leaves school.

words.tr: phrase. 学生公告板
words.ex: The student notice board has a new message about the exam.
words.ex_cn: 学生告示板上有一条关于考试的新通知。
words.en: A board where notices for students are posted, often found in schools or universities.

words.tr: phrase. 学号；学生编号
words.ex: Please enter your student number to access the online portal.
words.ex_cn: 请输入您的学生编号以访问在线门户。
words.en: A unique number assigned to a student by an educational institution for identification purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 学生代表
words.ex: The student representative spoke at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 学生代表在会议上发言了。
words.en: A student representative is a student who is chosen or elected to represent the views of all the students in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍楼；供学生居住的住宿大楼
words.ex: The student lives in the residential hall near the library.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A building or group of buildings where students live, typically on a university campus.

words.tr: phrase. 学生服务中心
words.ex: The student service centre helps students with their problems.
words.ex_cn: 学生服务中心帮助学生解决他们的问题。
words.en: A facility within an educational institution that provides various support services to students, such as academic advising, counseling, and career services.

words.tr: phrase. 学生服务（指为学生提供的各类支持与帮助，如咨询、住宿、就业指导等）
words.ex: The student services office helps with housing and loans.
words.ex_cn: 学生服务中心帮助解决住宿和贷款问题。
words.en: Student services refer to the range of support services provided by educational institutions to assist students in their academic and personal development. These services can include academic advising, counseling, career services, and health services, among others.

words.tr: phrase. 学生会
words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.tr: phrase. 已教授的课程；指由教师授课而非自学的课程
words.ex: The taught courses were all completed last semester.
words.ex_cn: 这些已教授的课程都在上学期完成了。
words.en: Courses that have been instructed or delivered by a teacher or professor.

words.tr: phrase. 教学设施
words.ex: The school has good teaching facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的教学设施。
words.en: Teaching facilities refer to the physical resources and equipment available in educational institutions to support the delivery of instruction and enhance learning experiences.

words.tr: 教科书：一本用于教学的书籍，通常包含特定学科的知识和信息。
words.ex: The teacher gave us a math textbook.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一本数学教科书。
words.en: A book used for the study of a particular subject, especially in schools and colleges.

words.tr: phrase. 化学考试的结果
words.ex: The chemistry exam results came out yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 化学考试成绩昨天公布了。
words.en: The outcomes of a test in the subject of chemistry.

words.tr: phrase. （图书馆的）借还书服务台
words.ex: He went to the circulation desk to return his book.
words.ex_cn: 他去借还书台还书。
words.en: The circulation desk is a place in a library where books are borrowed and returned.

words.tr: phrase. 批判性文学理论；指对文学作品进行批判性分析与阐释的理论体系
words.ex: He reads the critical literature theory for his research.
words.ex_cn: 他为了研究而阅读批判性文学理论。
words.en: The critical literature theory refers to a field of study that examines literature through the lens of critical theory, analyzing texts for their social, political, and ideological implications.

words.tr: phrase. 最后一年；毕业学年
words.ex: He is working hard in the final year of high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中的最后一年努力学习。
words.en: The last year of a particular period, especially in education.

words.tr: phrase. 通用生物学技术实验室
words.ex: The students work in the generic biology technology lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在通用生物技术实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory for studying general biological techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 讲座管理；指对讲座活动的组织、安排与协调工作
words.ex: The lecture management system is slow.
words.ex_cn: 讲座管理系统很慢。
words.en: The organization and administration of a lecture series or course.

words.tr: phrase. 最低限度的标记或痕迹
words.ex: He got the minimal mark to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了及格的最低分数。
words.en: The minimal mark refers to the lowest score or grade that is required to achieve a certain standard or to pass a test or course.

words.tr: phrase. 心理学系；负责心理学教学与研究的学术部门
words.ex: He works in the psychology department.
words.ex_cn: 他在心理学系工作。
words.en: The psychology department is a division within a university or college that focuses on the study of the mind and behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 最近的研究
words.ex: The recent study shows that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 最近的研究表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The latest research or investigation conducted on a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 学生福利干事；负责学生福利事务的官员
words.ex: The student welfare officer helps students with personal problems.
words.ex_cn: 学生福利官帮助学生解决个人问题。
words.en: A student welfare officer is a person responsible for the well-being and support of students within an educational institution.

words.tr: phrase. 访问教授；客座教授
words.ex: The visiting professor teaches English at our school.
words.ex_cn: 这位访问教授在我们学校教英语。
words.en: A visiting professor is a professor who is teaching at a university or college for a limited period of time, typically a semester or a year, and is not a permanent member of the faculty.

words.tr: phrase. 旅行奖学金
words.ex: She was awarded travel scholarships to study abroad.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了旅行奖学金，可以去国外学习。
words.en: A travel scholarship is a financial grant awarded to individuals to support their travel for educational or research purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 学费（指大学或教育机构收取的费用）
words.ex: He pays tuition fees every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期支付学费。
words.en: Tuition fees are the money that you pay to be taught, especially in a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 教学辅导室；用于个别或小组辅导的教学房间
words.ex: We meet in the tutorial room every Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周二在辅导室见面。
words.en: A room used for small group teaching or individual instruction, often in a university or college setting.

words.tr: phrase. 大学住宿
words.ex: He lives in university accommodation near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 他住在靠近校园的大学宿舍里。
words.en: University accommodation refers to the housing provided by a university for its students, typically located on or near the campus.

words.tr: phrase. 大学管理部门；校方
words.ex: The university authorities closed the library early.
words.ex_cn: 大学管理部门提前关闭了图书馆。
words.en: The governing body or administrative officials of a university.

words.tr: phrase. 大学建筑；高校楼宇
words.ex: The university buildings are old but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 大学的建筑很旧但很美丽。
words.en: The structures and facilities that constitute a university, including classrooms, libraries, and administrative offices.

words.tr: phrase. 大学课程
words.ex: He is taking a university course in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修一门大学生物学课程。
words.en: A university course is a series of classes or lectures on a particular subject, leading to an examination or qualification.

words.tr: phrase. 大学的院系；高校各部门
words.ex: The university departments offer many courses.
words.ex_cn: 大学的各个系提供许多课程。
words.en: The academic divisions within a university that focus on specific areas of study.

words.tr: phrase. 大学生；在大学就读的学生
words.ex: University students often study algebra.
words.ex_cn: 大学生经常学习代数。
words.en: Individuals enrolled in higher education institutions pursuing academic degrees.

words.tr: phrase. 大学教学；高等教育中的授课活动
words.ex: University teaching often involves a combination of lectures and practical sessions.
words.ex_cn: 大学教学通常包括讲座和实践环节的结合。
words.en: The profession or practice of teaching at a university.

words.tr: phrase. 大学网站；高等院校的官方网站
words.ex: He checked the university website for the exam schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了大学网站上的考试安排。
words.en: A university website is an online platform provided by a university to offer information and services.

words.tr: phrase. 撰写论文；写作文章（通常指学术性或议论性文章）
words.ex: He spends every weekend on writing essays for his history class.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都花时间撰写历史课的论文。
words.en: The act of composing essays, which are short pieces of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 书面作业；写作任务
words.ex: He finished his written assignments before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了他的书面作业。
words.en: Written pieces of work, such as essays, reports, or exercises, completed for study.

words.tr: phrase. 书面课程作业；以书面形式完成的课业任务
words.ex: The teacher assigned a written coursework on the history of art.
words.ex_cn: 老师布置了一项关于艺术史的书面作业。
words.en: Work assigned by an educational institution to be completed in writing, often as part of a course assessment.

words.tr: phrase. 收藏书籍；收藏类图书
words.ex: He has a collection of books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有一系列藏书。
words.en: Books that are collected and kept as a group, often for their value or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 课程办公室，负责管理课程相关事务的办公部门
words.ex: Please contact the course office for further information about the curriculum.
words.ex_cn: 如需进一步了解课程信息，请联系教务处。
words.en: A department or administrative office within an educational institution that handles matters related to specific academic programs or courses, such as enrollment, scheduling, and student advising.
